system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Echo spanning tree algorithm. It extends the Echo specification and instantiates the constants with a small fully-connected graph of three nodes to enable exhaustive state-space exploration by a model checker.
actors_and_components: Same as the Echo specification: a set of nodes in an undirected connected graph with a single initiator. This module defines a concrete three-node graph and picks one node as the initiator.
state_variables: Inherits all state variables from the Echo specification. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: Same as the Echo specification, instantiated with a three-node fully-meshed graph where every pair of distinct nodes is connected. One node is chosen deterministically as the initiator.
actions: Inherits all actions from the Echo specification without modification. A test variant of the specification is also provided that prints the graph adjacency relation to standard output at startup.
safety_properties: Inherits from the Echo specification: type correctness and the spanning tree ancestor properties (at termination, the initiator is an ancestor of all other nodes and the ancestor relation is acyclic).
model_bounds: The node set consists of three string-valued nodes. The graph is fully meshed (every distinct pair of nodes is connected). The initiator is chosen deterministically from the node set. An alternative graph definition uses a nondeterministic choice of any connected, symmetric, irreflexive graph over the node set.
additional_assumptions: This module is designed for model checking only. The fully-meshed graph ensures all assumptions of the Echo specification (connectivity, symmetry, irreflexivity) are satisfied. A sentinel constant for the no-parent value is declared as a model value distinct from all nodes.
